clue.text: Making his mark somewhat shakily in a disputed area

indicators.note: written somewhat shakily, the letters of the two words wobble out of order and are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone signs their name with a trembling hand in a contested region.
explanation.walkthrough: 'somewhat shakily' shuffles HISMARK; 'Making' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Kashmir is a Himalayan region whose sovereignty is contested by India, Pakistan and China.

clue.text: Having like-minded companion, drink red —- sip it after decanting

indicators.note: decanting pours wine out of its bottle, so these letters are poured into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone with a congenial friend drinks red wine, sipping it once decanted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after decanting' rearranges DRINKREDSIPIT; 'Having' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A kindred spirit is a person whose tastes and outlook match one's own.

clue.text: In fire, save antique instrument

parts.note: to sack is to dismiss from a job
save means but, except

explanation.surface: In a blaze, rescue an old musical instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: The sackbut is the Renaissance forerunner of the trombone.

clue.text: The height of a horse

definitions.meaning: a peak or hill, as in a named mountain

explanation.definitionFit: Mount names both a hill or mountain and the animal a rider sits on.

clue.text: Distinguished Frenchman conceals particular dislike initially …

indicators.note: the name hides the next word inside it

parts.note: Rene is a French man's name
own means particular to oneself

indicators.note: only the first letter of the word is used

explanation.surface: A notable Frenchman hides an early, specific distaste.
explanation.definitionFit: Renowned means famous and celebrated, as a distinguished person is.

clue.text: A divine being enthroned in Pennsylvania temple

indicators.note: one thing seated on a throne within another is placed inside it

parts.note: PA is the standard abbreviation for the US state of Pennsylvania
a divine being is a god

explanation.surface: A deity sits on a throne in a Pennsylvanian place of worship.
explanation.definitionFit: A pagoda is a tiered tower serving as a Buddhist or Hindu temple.

clue.text: … cultured East European hides it …

indicators.note: the nationality word keeps the other piece inside it

parts.note: a Pole is from Poland in eastern Europe

explanation.surface: A refined man from Poland conceals something.
explanation.definitionFit: Polite can mean refined or cultivated, as in polite society.

clue.text: … German school enjoys my amusing capering

indicators.note: capering is skipping about playfully, so these letters dance into a new order

explanation.surface: A school in Germany delights in my comic antics.
explanation.walkthrough: In Germany a Gymnasium is an academic secondary school, not a sports hall.
explanation.definitionFit: The Gymnasium is the German grammar-school equivalent preparing pupils for university.

clue.text: One gets criticised for covering up particulars

indicators.note: the reversed word covers, or wraps, the other piece
in a down answer up means read from bottom to top

parts.note: slated means harshly criticised
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone is criticised for hiding the facts.
explanation.walkthrough: SLATED read 'up' gives DETALS, which covers I.
explanation.definitionFit: Details are individual facts or items, the particulars of a matter.

clue.text: Dash to Canal Turn — except at night

indicators.note: dash as a verb means to smash or scatter, so these letters are broken up and rearranged

parts.note: the letters of these three words form the pool

explanation.surface: Advice to rush to the famous Grand National fence, but not after dark.
explanation.walkthrough: Composite anagram: the letters of TO CANAL TURN, 'except' the letters AT, rearrange to give the answer. Canal Turn is a fence on the Grand National racecourse at Aintree.
explanation.definitionFit: Nocturnal is the adjective meaning happening or active by night.

clue.text: Test provided theme

parts.note: the MOT is the annual roadworthiness test for British cars
provided means if, as a condition

explanation.surface: A vehicle examination was offered as a subject.
explanation.walkthrough: MOT is the yearly compulsory safety test for cars in the UK.
explanation.definitionFit: A motif is a recurring theme or idea in art, music or writing.

clue.text: Fool half sprawls on armchair for French entertainment

indicators.note: only the first half of the word is used

parts.note: lies means sprawls, lounges
a bergere is an upholstered French armchair

explanation.surface: A clown lounges in an easy chair for a French show.
explanation.definitionFit: The Folies Bergere is the famous Paris music hall and its cabaret revue.

clue.text: With black nose outstanding android

indicators.note: read as standing outside: the word for nose wraps round the other letter

parts.note: to root is to nose about, as a pig does with its snout
B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils

explanation.surface: An android with a prominent dark nose.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nose' looks like a noun but is the verb, to search by snuffling; 'outstanding' means standing out(side), putting ROOT around B.
explanation.definitionFit: An android is a humanlike machine, the classic science-fiction robot.

clue.text: Anne put up so heartily

definitions.meaning: Anne Hathaway, Shakespeare's wife, tolerated life alongside William: she put up with her Will

explanation.walkthrough: The first definition is a pun: Anne Hathaway married Will Shakespeare, so she 'put up with a Will'.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an idiom for doing something vigorously and with determination, much as heartily does.

clue.text: Kind of shop featured (after area became variable) in reorganisation

indicators.note: the letters are reorganised into a new order
one letter turning into another signals a swap

parts.note: Y is a conventional algebraic variable

explanation.surface: A type of store was showcased, after a region changed, during a restructure.
explanation.walkthrough: In FEATURED, 'area' (A) 'became' 'variable' (Y), giving FEYTURED, which 'in reorganisation' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: A duty-free shop sells goods exempt from import tax, typically at airports.

clue.text: Safety device, one proper to install in agricultural build — ing

indicators.note: installing puts something inside, here inside the building

parts.note: a farm is an agricultural building
I is the Roman numeral for one
real means proper, genuine

explanation.surface: A safety gadget is properly fitted in a barn.
explanation.walkthrough: The dash in 'build — ing' is a line-break hyphen from the printed page; the word is building.
explanation.definitionFit: A fire alarm is a device that warns of fire.

clue.text: Time to publish paper

parts.note: to issue a magazine or statement is to publish it

explanation.surface: It is the moment to bring out a newspaper.
explanation.definitionFit: Tissue is thin soft paper, used for wrapping or as a handkerchief.

clue.text: Depressed chap used to make vases

parts.note: blue means sad
John is a typical man's name

explanation.surface: A sad man was employed in pottery.
explanation.walkthrough: Blue John is a banded fluorspar found only in Derbyshire, England, carved into vases and bowls.
explanation.definitionFit: This ornamental Derbyshire mineral is prized for carving decorative vases.

clue.text: Criticise sample in store

parts.note: to pan is to review harshly
to try food is to sample it

explanation.surface: Find fault with a taste test in a shop.
explanation.definitionFit: A pantry is a small room or cupboard where food is stored.

clue.text: By the sound of it, arrested crew shut their eyes momentarily

indicators.note: signals that the words are heard, not written

parts.note: nicked means arrested and an eight is a rowing crew

explanation.surface: A gang under arrest blinked briefly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nicked' + 'eight' said quickly sounds like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To nictate is to blink or wink, a technical term.

clue.text: Weight builder put on a exactly

indicators.note: one piece is placed after the other in the across answer

parts.note: plumb as an adverb means exactly, as in plumb in the middle
Bob the Builder is the children's television character

explanation.surface: A builder gained weight to the precise amount.
explanation.walkthrough: Bob the Builder is a British children's TV character; the 'a' in this clue is an OCR slip, as the page reads 'put on exactly'.
explanation.definitionFit: A plumb bob is the weight hung on a line to find the true vertical.

clue.text: Lawyers reach an understanding

parts.note: the Bar is the body of barristers
to gain a place is to reach it

explanation.surface: Lawyers come to an agreement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reach an understanding' reads as one phrase; it splits into wordplay and definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A bargain is an agreement between parties, a deal.

clue.text: Horrified military commanders start to tour round hospital

indicators.note: the commanders' letters go round the hospital letter

parts.note: agas are Ottoman military commanders

indicators.note: only the first letter of the word is used

explanation.surface: Commanders are appalled at beginning a hospital round.
explanation.walkthrough: An aga (or agha) was a commander in the Ottoman Empire.
explanation.definitionFit: Aghast means filled with horror or shock.

clue.text: Four sides involved in this playground conflict

parts.note: rec, short for recreation ground, is a public playground
a tangle is a fight or dispute, as in to tangle with someone

explanation.surface: A four-way scrap in a school playground.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Four sides' looks like the people fighting; it is the shape's definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A four-sided figure with right angles is the familiar oblong shape.

clue.text: Less immoral ecstasy conveyed by low sound of contentment

indicators.note: something conveyed by a vehicle is carried inside it

parts.note: a cat's purr is a low contented sound
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: Something more virtuous communicated by a happy murmur of rapture.
explanation.definitionFit: Purer, comparative of pure, can mean more morally clean or chaste.

clue.text: Pair with a system to produce crystal

parts.note: an ism is a system of belief

explanation.surface: Two things combined with an organised method yield a crystal.
explanation.definitionFit: A prism is a transparent solid, often glass or crystal, that refracts light.

clue.text: I gained admission to Scarlett's home for a crown

indicators.note: getting into a place means one letter goes inside the word

parts.note: Tara is the plantation home of Scarlett O'Hara in Gone with the Wind

explanation.surface: Someone got into the O'Hara mansion in search of a jewelled headpiece.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiara is a jewelled ornamental band worn on the head, a small crown.

clue.text: Condemn a vessel about minute point

indicators.note: the vessel's letters go round the next piece

parts.note: a boat is a vessel
E (east) is a compass point

explanation.surface: Denounce a ship over a tiny detail.
explanation.definitionFit: To abominate is to loathe and denounce something as detestable.

clue.text: Pass through American seat of learning

parts.note: per means through or by means of
MIT is the Massachusetts Institute of Technology

explanation.surface: Getting through a US university.
explanation.definitionFit: A permit is a pass authorising entry or an activity.

clue.text: No explosive exposé finally — he may shield one

parts.note: a mine is a buried explosive

indicators.note: only the closing letter of the word is used

explanation.surface: No bombshell revelation at the end, as someone may cover for another.
explanation.walkthrough: A nominee may hold shares in their name on behalf of someone who stays hidden.
explanation.definitionFit: A nominee holding assets for another person keeps that owner's identity out of view.
